rankingRules: RFEF (LaLiga): points; head-to-head points and goal difference among clubs level (re-applied to sub-groups); overall goal difference; goals scored; fair play (not in the data, never broken at random). Head-to-head only when complete. Competition point adjustments applied to final tables.
model: Weighted Poisson team ratings (attack, defence, home), time-decayed, shrunk to a prior (league average, or promoted teams' average learnt from earlier seasons); optional Dixon–Coles; fitted strictly before each forecast date.

UD Almería.note: Point deduction: Almería ended the season on 29 points (32 from results). Source: citation 'Almería retira el recurso y acaba la Liga con 29 puntos' on the 2014–15 SD Eibar season page. Does not change any position (19th either way).

logLossBelowBaseRates.text: Hold-out log loss at least 2% below the past-frequency baseline

calibrationEce.text: Expected calibration error ≤ 0.05 for home win, draw and away win (hold-out)

relegationBrierBelowPosition.text: Relegation Brier score at matchday 13 below the position baseline (2015/16–2025/26)
